definitions.gloss: prohibition; ban; interdict; decree forbidding something
definitions.explanation: An official order or law prohibiting something. Can refer to both historical edicts and modern regulations. More formal and authoritative than simply 禁止.

examples.japanese: {禁令|きんれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
{禁令|きんれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{処罰|しょばつ}→処罰：21006_shobatsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Those who violated the ban were punished.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}→江戸：19369_edo⟧⟦{幕府|ばくふ}→幕府：12448_bakufu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦キリスト{教|きょう}→キリスト教：10823_kirisutokyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{禁令|きんれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{長期間|ちょうきかん}→長期間：25696_choukikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって⟦{維持|いじ}した→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧。
examples.english: The Edo shogunate maintained the ban on Christianity for a long period.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, authoritative word often used in historical or legal contexts. Frequently appears in discussions of historical bans and edicts, but also used for modern prohibitions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {禁令|きんれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to issue a ban)
- {禁令|きんれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧ (to break a ban)
- {禁令|きんれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧ (to lift a ban)
- {禁令|きんれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to violate a ban)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: prohibition — more general and modern
- ⟦{法令|ほうれい}→法令：13299_hourei⟧: law/ordinance — broader, covering all types of legal orders
